### What the project does:
The project is called **WanGP** (formerly/also known as Wan2GP). It is described as a "one-stop super app for the best open source generative models across video, image, audio, and text-to-speech." 
Yes, it is definitely related to **Wan 2.1** video generation! It supports a wide array of models including:
- **Video:** Wan 2.1/2.2, LTX-2, Hunyuan Video 1/1.5, LongCat, Kandinsky, and more.
- **Image:** Qwen Image, Z-Image, Flux 1/2, HiDream.
- **Audio/TTS:** Qwen3 TTS, Ace Step, Stable Audio 3, etc.

It includes features tailored for local execution on a wide range of hardware ("accessible to the GPU poor"), including low VRAM requirements (down to 6 GB), support for older Nvidia GPUs (GTX 10XX series and up), and AMD GPUs. It provides a full web UI, queue management, LoRA support, video masking/upsampling, and built-in AI agents for automating tedious tasks.

### Can it generate a video locally without paid API keys?
**Yes, absolutely.** The project is entirely designed to run these models locally on your own hardware (via Python/Conda or Docker). The README explicitly states: 
> "**WanGP is free to use locally.** The official project will never ask you to pay a license fee, subscription, or donation to run WanGP on your own computer..."

Since it runs open-source models directly on your GPU, there are no API keys or paid subscriptions required to generate videos.
